fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Time_Type
fields.description: Format of local IKE certificate "not after" time: X'00': Manual tunnel - unused X'01': Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) X'02': Generalized Time (GT) Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Time
fields.description: Local IKE certificate "not after" time: If the time type is UTC (SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Time_Type = X'01'), the first 13 bytes of this field contain the time in UTC format (YYMMDDhhmmssZ). If the time type is GT (SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Time

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Key_Type
fields.description: Local IKE certificate key type. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_SCert_Key_Type .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_LclCert_Key_Len
fields.description: Local IKE certificate key length in bits.

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Sign_Meth
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate signature method. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_SCert_Signature_Method .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Enc_Meth
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate encryption method. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_SCert_Enc_Method .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Digest_Alg
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate digest algorithm. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_SCert_Digest_Alg .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_Rsvd3
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Serial_Len
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate serial number length in bytes. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Serial
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate serial number, left justified. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Time_Type
fields.description: Format of remote IKE certificate "not after" time: X'00': Manual tunnel - unused X'01': Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) X'02': Generalized Time (GT) Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Time
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate "not after" time: If the time type is UTC (SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Time_Type = X'01'), the first 13 bytes of this field contain the time in UTC format (YYMMDDhhmmssZ). If the time type is GT (SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Tim

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Key_Type
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate key type. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_SCert_Key_Type .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_RmtCert_Key_Len
fields.description: Remote IKE certificate key length in bits. IPsec (Phase 2) tunnel information

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_TunID
fields.description: IPSec tunnel identifier. This value is displayed as Ytunid or Mtunid in ipsec command displays. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_TunFlags
fields.description: IP tunnel flags: X'80': IPv6 indicator. If set, security endpoint addresses and data endpoint addresses are IPv6; otherwise, they are IPv4. X'40': FIPS 140 mode indicator. If this field is set, cryptographic operations for this tunnel are p

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_TunType
fields.description: Tunnel type. One of the following values: X'01': Manual IPSec tunnel X'02': Dynamic IPSec tunnel X'03': Shadow tunnel

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_TunState
fields.description: One of the following tunnel states: X'01': Manual or dynamic tunnel is active. X'02': Manual tunnel is inactive.

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_Rsvd4
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_EncapMode
fields.description: One of the following tunnel encapsulation modes: X'01': Tunnel Mode X'02': Transport Mode

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_AuthProto
fields.description: The protocol used for message authentication. One of the following: X'32' Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) X'33': Authentication Header (AH)

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_AuthAlg
fields.description: One of the following tunnel authentication algorithms. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_CS_Msg_Auth .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_EncAlg
fields.description: One of the following tunnel encryption algorithms. Same values as SMF119SC_TLS_CS_Enc_Alg .

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_PFSGroup
fields.description: Diffie-Hellman group used for perfect forward secrecy. Same values as SMF119SC_IPSec_IKETunDHGroup.

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_Lifesize
fields.description: SA lifesize in KBytes. Zero if SMF119SC_IPSec_TunType is set to 1. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_Lifetime
fields.description: SA lifetime in minutes. Zero if SMF119SC_IPSec_TunType is set to 1. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_IPSec_VPNLifeExpire
fields.description: Tunnel VPN lifetime in minutes (length of time after which the tunnel family ceases to be refreshed). Zero indicates no VPN lifetime limit is enforced. Information only

fields.name: SMF119SC_DN_Len
fields.description: Length of the DN structure (includes the length of SMF119SC_DN_Len, SMF119SC_DN_Type, and SMF119SC_DN)

fields.description: The variable length DN value (up to 1024)
